invitation.rationale: Move the right wrist14 units outward and11 down from(393,447), then compare orientation at exactly the same wrist position. The original right mitten has a thumb-like top bump; rotation can change its reading without altering anatomy.
invitation.rotationUncertainty: The+32degree candidate may still read as a thumb-up. Compare-26degrees with the same position. Neither is pre-approved as palm-up; the original drawing is a stylized mitten and its exact semantic read needs rendered evidence.
invitation.trajectory: Keep the hand low as the face returns, then move outward and slightly up into the held offer. This is one small presenting arc. The head/gaze lead the invitation rather than waiting for a simultaneous full-body pose change.
invitation.freeLeft: Keep the existing low neutral free left initially. If another source change lowers it, compare that separately from the presenting-wrist rotation.
invitation.keepStatic: Leave the opposite wing, torso scale, feet, question and interface still. Existing modest right-wing opening is enough support.
invitation.acceptance: Compared at identical scale and theme with the baseline, the outer mitten is visibly separate from the ruff and the return-to-offer change reads as a deliberate small presentation without a longer-arm or adult-proportioned impression.

phoneAttentionAdvice.owner: interaction engineer/root, outside motion.js advisory ownership
phoneAttentionAdvice.target: Actual h2 question center from the unchanged neutral eye midpoint in current layout, not the viewport edge or a hardcoded right cue.
phoneAttentionAdvice.exampleMeaning: Illustrative phone values, not an instruction to override measured layout geometry. Looking up is primary; the right component should remain small for the inspected composition.
phoneAttentionAdvice.timing: Attention starts during antenna150/gaze330; head follows330–790; read1190–1900; contextual adjustment returns to zero by2350.
phoneAttentionAdvice.scan: The original read gazeY+3 must not make the phone character look down away from the question. Retain at most about1unit of scan while remaining decisively upward, or scan along the text target plane.
phoneAttentionAdvice.headSupport: For a strongly above target, attenuate lateral headX/headR; p.headY*.25-3 is a reasonable bounded hypothesis for the read headY4→-2. Keep head roll close to0, within roughly±2degrees here. Body and limbs stay authored.
phoneAttentionAdvice.continuity: Use cached measured geometry; resize or orientation changes must not snap the gaze. Retarget smoothly or freeze the target through one performance and recompute for the next.
phoneAttentionAdvice.scopeLimit: This advice improves a causal attention cue; it does not certify the first-viewport composition, physical-phone behavior or unprimed comprehension.

score.reason: The actual candidate sheet supports a scoped provisional B selection. Full implemented motion, small-size contact families and contextual phone attention have not yet been inspected by this advisor. The requested honest9 remains an aspiration, not a required score.

actualCandidateAssessment.method: Viewed the actual matched day/night sheet using view_image; all four columns retain the same face, body, wings and scale.
actualCandidateAssessment.before: Presenting mitten touches the ruff-side band and has an acknowledgement/thumb accent.
actualCandidateAssessment.A: Outward/down placement improves space, but the positive rotation retains the acknowledgement/thumb accent.
actualCandidateAssessment.B: The two small top lobes face upward and the right mitten is visibly more separate from the ruff. This is the clearest small stylized presenting shape in the inspected sheet.
actualCandidateAssessment.C: The lower inward position recedes toward the torso/wing junction and has less deliberate outward presentation.
actualCandidateAssessment.recommendation: Use B provisionally for the implemented return-to-offer sequence; preserve the current reach and anatomy. Further extension or larger hands is not justified by this sheet.
actualCandidateAssessment.challenge: B is not a literal human palm, and the static sheet cannot prove audience interpretation or continuous phrasing. Keep those claims separate.
actualCandidateAssessment.followup: Inspect the2350→2720ms+10→-26degree rotation while the wrist moves outward: it must accompany one small arc, not read as a wrist flick. Inspect96/128/160px and contextual phone frames before final adoption.
